무엇: Material disclosures filed by listed Korean companies, selected the way a US Form 8-K is: only events that move a decision.

delisting-risk.뜻: Delisting review, watch-list designation, trading halt, or market-value shortfall

earnings-swing.뜻: Disclosure of a material change in revenue or profit structure

supply-contract.뜻: A single sales or supply contract large enough to require disclosure

cancellation.뜻: Decision to cancel treasury or other shares

ceo-change.뜻: Appointment, dismissal or replacement of the representative director

control-change.뜻: A transaction that changes, or pledges shares of, the largest shareholder

buyback.뜻: Decision to acquire the company’s own shares

rights-issue.뜻: Decision to issue new shares for cash

director-change.뜻: Appointment, dismissal or early departure of an outside director

bonus-issue.뜻: Decision to issue new shares without payment

acquisition.뜻: Decision to acquire shares or equity securities of another company

rumor-response.en: Response to a report or rumour
rumor-response.뜻: The company answering a press report or market rumour

debt-guarantee.뜻: Decision to guarantee another party’s debt

proxy-solicitation.뜻: Reference documents for soliciting the exercise of voting rights

material-event.뜻: A management matter the company judges relevant to an investment decision

related-party-financing.뜻: Borrowing from, lending to, or subscribing for shares of a related party

cb-repricing.뜻: Adjustment of the conversion price of an outstanding convertible bond

major-report.뜻: A report on material matters that does not fall into the categories above
